test_title: PYST 3: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. All number are single-digit numbers. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 5 # % 2 ^ @ 3 & 1 $ 7 Ω 5 2 # 6 * 1 9 (Right)

How many symbols in the series are immediately preceded by a number and immediately followed by a symbol?
